purpose: Track coverage and gaps for the RTEC work-mail review without retaining personal mail, raw work mail, or person-level case details.
scope_boundary: This tracked file contains RTEC work-mail coverage only. Personal mailbox coverage and user-specific work history are maintained separately in a local-only private checkpoint.

work.document_candidate_filter: Filename-only matches for blank, template, handbook, policy, procedure, manual, guide, form, or report; many hits belong to person-specific records and are not safe by filename alone.

method_notes: The local work-mail index is read-only and caught up.
A deterministic lexical pass touched each indexed work message body to produce topic-discovery counts; these are overlapping search leads, not human semantic review or HR process metrics.
Messages without indexed bodies and all attachment content remain explicit review gaps.
Mailbox files, full message bodies, credentials, employee/applicant identities, and case narratives are excluded from this tracked record.
next_steps: Review full message bodies in bounded, deduplicated batches and capture only corroborated process knowledge or durable user context.
Inspect work attachments selectively; do not run the all-attachments exporter. One visually verified blank Guardian reference packet is preserved in the RTEC source library.
Use position-level sources to validate historical claims and preserve only safe reference documents.
